confirmation_rule: unused BETA S1..S70 after v2 and v5-v9 roles, SHA256(v10-spatial-harmonic:filename) ascending, first 5
preprocessing: full available trial, crop then 6-90 Hz zero-phase Butterworth and channel standardization, 250 Hz, no padding
fusion: equal average of per-trial class-z-scored fbcca3_all and fbcca3_posterior
selection: highest development subject-macro accuracy; tie in candidate order; require >=2 percentage points over fbcca3_all
promotion: selected method requires >=2 percentage points gain on fresh confirmation and >=4/5 subjects nonnegative versus fbcca3_all; otherwise v9 stays default
competition_data: D1/D2 verification only, never used for candidate choice or promotion
